# Seasonedz Group

> South African business selling educational, Bible and mindfulness colouring books, acrylic paint markers, rotating crayons and colouring book bundles for kids, families, schools and churches. Ships countrywide in South Africa.

This file is an optional, machine-readable summary for AI tools that choose to read it. It does not affect Google Search ranking or indexing — Google has stated llms.txt is not a ranking input. The full, authoritative set of indexable pages is /sitemap.xml.

## Shop

- [All products](https://www.seasonedzgroup.co.za/shop/): Full catalogue of colouring books, markers and crayons.
- [Kids Colouring Books](https://www.seasonedzgroup.co.za/category/kids-colouring-books/): Educational colouring books for children.
- [Bible Colouring Books](https://www.seasonedzgroup.co.za/category/bible-colouring-books/): Christian colouring books for Sunday school and family devotion.
- [Mindfulness Colouring](https://www.seasonedzgroup.co.za/category/mindfulness-colouring/): Adult colouring for quiet, screen-free time.
- [Markers and Crayons](https://www.seasonedzgroup.co.za/category/markers-and-crayons/): Acrylic paint markers and rotating wax crayons.
- [Bundles](https://www.seasonedzgroup.co.za/category/bundles/): Colouring book and supplies bundles.
